checks.test: 1. "那个约定就算了" leaves an address preference untouched
2. with three threads, withdrawing one topic retires only that topic
3. an explicit global withdrawal retires everything, and only then
4. an ambiguous withdrawal changes nothing and asks which one
5. "别再叫我小林，叫我阿林" replaces the old value; only the new one is injected
6. "不要这样称呼我" without a new name retires the old value and does not guess
7. deleting the source message removes its evidence and the thread stops being injected
8. deleting the whole conversation removes every relationship evidence row
9. a restored backup that predates the deletion does not revive the evidence (reconcile)
9b. restoring a backup after the conversation was deleted does not revive the evidence
10. a relationship write that fails stays queued and applies once on retry
13. replaying one turn ten times adds one relationship evidence row and one memory revision
11. a multi-fact batch whose verification fails is rolled back, not partially kept
12. an index failure that later recovers ends at a verified state, not a silent success
14. a rebuilt runtime on the same database keeps address, fact and state
15. a plain negation is not distress, while an explicit request for a fix is executed
16. the greeting and preference guidance exists in the principles the model receives
17. no expression policy changes the facts or the sensitivity ceiling
18. retracted, superseded and deleted threads never reach the payload
